US-Iran tensions escalate with drone downing and advisories

Tensions between the US and Iran have intensified following Iran's downing of an MQ-9 Reaper drone and strikes on US bases and Gulf allies. The US has conducted multiple consecutive nights of strikes against Iran. In response to the escalating conflict, India has issued advisories for its citizens in Iran to leave the country.
